where: Damage tab rendered before/after (labels, folds, numbers) + condcheck CLAUSE rows
why: Audited all 448 CLAUSE rows (198 distinct clauses) and, separately, every main clause the builder’s check keeps with 50–99% of its words (68, re-run on rd-old/rd-new with a 100% threshold). Corrections all as GW: Enraged Behemoths (Tyranids: “add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model’s unit is Below Half-strength” — main’s “at N or fewer wounds left” was an app reading), Pledges, Doctrina, Methodical Destruction, Singular Purpose, Soul Sight, Spirit Thief. My 5 regressions render fixed (own build: Driven, Phaeron ×2 with working mutual exclusion, Hungry, Malefic, Doctrina row now “+1 AP with Conqueror Imperative or … (BATTLELINE, or within 6" …)”). Rules: WORKING (numbers only), REACH, USED, COST, PICKS, SOURCE, TITLE: sound in their hits. Unsound in principle: (a) TIMING’s regex also matches “this turn$”, “this (battle )?round”, “until the (end|start)”, so a real condition clause that ends in a time word is waved through — it hid Driven/Phaeron last round and still hides Daemonic Fury’s “a friendly BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6"” (helped World Eaters rows read only “Selected by it · [LANCE]”; GW: “Select one friendly WORLD EATERS unit within 6" of your unit”); (b) GW-QUOTE (“a row not counted shows GW’s words”) is applied to any row whose label starts with “, i.e. counted rows with a quoted condition (Glowin’ Dakka, Ruination’s Bounty, Strength from Exile, Deff from Above, Auto-divinatory, Damaged 4/5, Murderous Imperative) — no loss hidden in those hits; (c) SOURCE uses /i so its [A-Z] guard is void — hits are all real source names; (d) the 50% keep rule: of the 68 partial keeps only Daemonic Fury and Hungry for Combat lose meaning, the rest miss only a unit name now in the row title or a tokenisation (non-monster vs “not Monster”). Hungry for Combat “two”: GW TARGET “Two or more WAR DOG units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit”; the builder’s reason (“a TARGET count, not a condition of these attacks”) is inconsistent with the TARGET conditions other stratagem rows state (Avenge the Fallen below starting strength, Hack and Slash charged, Machine Spirit Resurgent below starting strength): minor, state it. Not tested: exclusion across the two steps of a Both turn (rows not drawn in Both’s first view).
